events.title: Homes of the Future: Reimagining the Great Australian Dream
events.description: A discussion on urban design, architecture, and the future of housing, exploring how emerging technology and changing societal needs are shifting the Australian residential landscape.

events.title: Interpreting archives: stories on the page, stories between the lines
events.location: Anzac Square Memorial Galleries, Brisbane City
events.description: An insightful session focused on historical literacy, where experts discuss how to decode archival documents to uncover hidden narratives and human perspectives.

events.title: Cirque du Soleil: KOOZA – Brisbane Season
events.location: Cirque du Soleil Big Top, Eagle Farm
events.description: An immersive, high-art circus performance blending physical theatre, acrobatic feats, and clowning with an exploration of human connection and performance art.

events.title: Fiesta De Kayak – Twilight Kayak
events.description: An outdoor guided adventure experience on the Brisbane River, providing a unique perspective of the city skyline during sunset and twilight hours.
